default.$description: Default border color for inputs, cards, and dividers at rest

error.$description: Border color for inputs/fields in an invalid or error state

focus.$description: Border applied when an element receives keyboard focus, for accessibility

end.$description: Ending color stop for borders using a gradient treatment

start.$description: Starting color stop for borders using a gradient treatment

info.$description: Border color for elements conveying neutral, informational context

strong.$description: Higher-contrast border for emphasis, e.g. active outlines or key dividers

subtle.$description: Faint border for low-emphasis separation, e.g. nested cards
